spec.name: Trend v33
spec.notes: Built for calm markets: the signal works in calm regimes and gives back part of it in stressed ones. Intended to run at reduced size when volatility is high.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.3, annual return 10%, maximum drawdown 14%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy's claimed performance is based on a short research period with no evidence of robustness or out-of-sample validation. The lack of detailed backtest data and the absence of any historical performance verification make it impossible to trust the results. The strategy should not be deployed with real capital.
